notes: One entry per building type (build_type), containing every level's cost/time/prerequisites.
Prerequisite `building_id` values resolve to {build_type, name_key, at_level, icon_sprite_path}.
English display names come from language_en.lua (see extract_language_names.py) — run merge_display_names.py against buildings_v2.json to fill display_name.
Icons are extracted separately by extract_building_icons.py — filenames match `icon_sprite_path`.
